sections.brief: The Dark Enlightenment / neoreaction as a body of texts (Yarvin/Moldbug 2007-2014, Land 2012); its four claims in plain words: democracy as failed, the Cathedral, exit over voice, neocameralism (state as joint-stock company with a CEO); formalism defined; what the shelf is not. Figures: flow, compare

The documented spine (texts, citation, money, people/posts) vs the overlay (rhyme, adjacency, style); convergence not coordination; Thiel's 2009 Cato sentence as worked example with his follow-up and 2023 Atlantic remark; the ladder of support. Figures: compare, flow

How the label spreads (Finley 2013 to Fink-Hafner and Sarmast 2025) checked against footnotes; who claims it (Land, Yarvin's own labels) and who denies or qualifies (Yarvin's denials, Vance adviser, Thiel 2023, Andreessen's citation of Land); neighbours kept distinct; the working hypothesis and the grading scales; worst-case reading tested. Figures: compare
